name: Pilismarót (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pilismarót (a quartered green, blue and maroon shield with a church, a sun, a tree and a wheel) below the name Pilismarót in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
